beats.name: ast: the overachiever: fills it in in a blur, then asks for more paper
rea: done in one second: one stroke, then stares at the teacher
sor: cheats: a shifty look each way, the answers glow onto the page by magic
wiz: a spell to answer the test goes wrong: an ink splat over the page
dra: his mind goes blank: his head steams, a snort of fire burns the test
phx: spends the whole test signing his name, then the bell goes
gun: guesses every answer: shoots a hole through each one
sam: sharpens his pencil the whole test: three cuts, a stub left
all: watches the clock: one lightning bolt and the hands race to the bell
vik: rubs out one mistake so hard the paper rips and the desk snaps in two

title: TEST: how each fighter takes a test
format: each-character-vs-X, one continuous take: fighters take turns at one desk, a new test each time, each takes it their own way
